row.proto: void Career_Set_DriverContractState(void *contract, uint16_t day, uint8_t state, uint32_t value)
row.notes: when the contract's active byte (+0x2c) is set: stores day (+0x10), state (+0x12) and value (+0x14), posts the contract message (vtable 0x145696e60) with the contract fields, and appends a history entry. The Driver Career replace path 0x140d766b0 calls it with state 3 on the outgoing driver's contract (found in [manager+0x350]+0x298 list by contract+0x50 == driver), day = clock/1440, value = vtable +0x108 of the entity's component registry, before posting his move to team 0x3fff with reason 1; Career_Sign_DriverToTeam calls it 4x  it clears the guard byte +0x2c, so a second call on the same contract does nothing

verify.notes: V0881 sigcheck OK. Proto right: rcx contract, dx day (u16 store 0x140d9de49), r8b state (0x140d9de4d), r9d value (0x140d9de51), no return. Guard byte +0x2c; message vt 0x145696e60 is MessageDriverContractChanged; history entries are 0x2c-byte copies of contract +0..+0x2c into the vector {allocator +0x30, begin +0x38, end +0x40, cap +0x48}. Signing call 0x140d777a8: contract = slot+8 of [comp+0x350]+0x298 matched on +0x50, day = (clock>>5)*0x5b05b06>>32, r8b = 3, r9d = eax of [comp+0x278]+0x1030 vt+0x108 (0x140d77736), then the move post with new team 0x3fff0000 and reason 1; Career_Sign_DriverToTeam has 4 calls (2 more in 0x140d94140, 0x140d958b0). Omission worth adding: the function clears the guard (+0x2c = 0) after the update, so a second call on the same contract does nothing until something sets it again
